manifest.name: Cycles Frame Pipeline
manifest.tagline: Overlap Cycles animation frame preparation and denoising
manifest.files: Read Blender scenes and write render frames, intermediates and logs
backend.tip: Select the side-by-side patched Blender executable for pipeline jobs
current.tip: Render the current scene, including unsaved edits
file.tip: Submit from an empty scene to reduce foreground Blender memory use
scene_file.tip: Select a .blend file to render in the background
profile.tip: Keep the scene settings or apply the measured Ruins preset
scene.tip: Use the settings saved in the scene
ruins.tip: HIP, 256 samples, 0.01 adaptive threshold, CPU OIDN and persistent data
output.tip: Write numbered PNG frames to this directory
mode.tip: Choose how completed frames are denoised and saved
native.tip: The patched engine can overlap output with the next frame. Stock Blender writes sequentially
serial.tip: Write frames sequentially to compare BVH changes with the same engine
compositor.tip: Denoise in a separate compositor. The result can differ from the original render
lookahead.tip: Use the selected BVH strategy in the patched engine
bvh_input.tip: Choose how Cycles prepares acceleration structures between frames
auto.tip: Ruins reuses the previous native tree. Other scenes evaluate the next frame ahead
next.tip: Build the next frame’s native tree while the GPU samples the current frame
previous.tip: Evaluate each frame once and rebuild changed regions with native Cycles
prepared.tip: Evaluate the next frame and validate and pack its native BVH while the GPU samples
threads.tip: CPU threads available to the background denoising process
existing.tip: Choose what to do when an output frame already exists
error.tip: Stop the job before overwriting an existing PNG
skip.tip: Keep existing PNGs and render the remaining frames
replace.tip: Render the requested frames and replace any existing PNGs
start.tip: Render the frame range in the background and confirm each frame after its PNG is saved
stop.tip: Stop submitting frames and let frames already in progress finish
log.tip: Open the render log for the active or most recent job
err.active: A pipeline job is already running
err.cycles: Set the scene render engine to Cycles first
err.range: The end frame is earlier than the start frame
err.mode: Parallel frame preparation requires Native Cycles Denoising and Output
err.backend: Select the patched Blender executable in the extension preferences
err.exe: The selected Blender executable could not be found
err.file: The selected .blend file could not be found
err.unsaved: Choose an absolute output path for an unsaved scene
err.snapshot: Could not create a render copy of the current edits
err.entry: The pipeline entry point is missing. Install the complete extension ZIP
status.exit: Job exited with code {code}. See the log for details
status.incomplete: Process exited with {done} of {total} frames confirmed
status.fallback: Using native rendering for some settings. See the log for details
